---
title: "Lean 4 Formalization"
subtitle: "Sorry-free formalization in Lean v4.35.0 + Mathlib"
jupyter: python3
---

The Lean 4 formalization lives in [`lean/MixedSignCoxeter/`](https://github.com/jkylearmstrong/mixed.sign.coxeter.systems/tree/main/lean/MixedSignCoxeter) and builds cleanly (`3390` jobs, zero `sorry`, zero `axiom`) against **Lean `v4.35.0`** and Mathlib.

## Formalization Progress

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import re
from pathlib import Path

lean_files = sorted(Path("lean/MixedSignCoxeter").glob("*.lean"))
counts = {"theorem": 0, "lemma": 0, "def": 0, "structure": 0, "sorry": 0}
for f in lean_files:
    text = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    counts["theorem"] += len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(?:private\s+)?theorem\b", text))
    counts["lemma"] += len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(?:private\s+)?lemma\b", text))
    counts["def"] += len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(?:private\s+)?(?:def|abbrev)\b", text))
    counts["structure"] += len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*structure\b", text))
    counts["sorry"] += len(re.findall(r"\bsorry\b", text))

print("| Metric | Count | Status |")
print("| :--- | :---: | :--- |")
print(f"| Lean 4 Modules | {len(lean_files)} | ✅ `lake build` passes |")
print(f"| Definitions & Structures | {counts['def'] + counts['structure']} | ✅ Complete |")
print(f"| Lemmas | {counts['lemma']} | ✅ Complete |")
print(f"| Theorems | {counts['theorem']} | ✅ Complete |")
print(f"| Remaining `sorry` | {counts['sorry']} | ✅ 100% sorry-free |")
```

## End-to-End Traceability (`data/theorems.yml`)

```text
Dissertation Theorem  ──▶  Lean 4 Theorem  ──▶  Python Implementation  ──▶  Interactive Explorer
```

The table below is generated directly from [`data/theorems.yml`](https://github.com/jkylearmstrong/mixed.sign.coxeter.systems/blob/main/data/theorems.yml), the same registry used by the Shiny Explorer's Theorem Checker.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml
from pathlib import Path

theorems = yaml.safe_load(Path("data/theorems.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["theorems"]
print("| Dissertation | Lean 4 Theorem | Python Implementation | Explorer Preset | Status |")
print("| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |")
for t in theorems:
    lean_col = f"[`{t['lean_symbol']}`]({t['lean_url']})" if t.get("lean_url") else "—"
    py_col = f"[`{t['python_ref']}`]({t['python_url']})"
    exp_col = f"[`{t['preset']}`](explorer.qmd)"
    print(f"| **{t['dissertation_ref']}**: {t['title']} | {lean_col} | {py_col} | {exp_col} | {t['status']} |")
```

## Building Locally

```bash
cd lean
lake exe cache get
lake build
```

## Module Dependency Architecture

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  Basic["Basic.lean<br/>ReflectionSystem, B, reflections"] --> Conj["Conjugacy.lean"]
  Basic --> Odd["OddCycles.lean"]
  Basic --> How["Howlett.lean<br/>Thm 1.1: w = -U⁻¹ Uᵀ"]
  Basic --> R2["RankTwo.lean"]
  R2 --> R2R["RankTwoRoots.lean"]
  Conj --> Bip["Bipartite.lean<br/>Thm 1.4, Prop 3.32"]
  Conj --> Comp["ComponentsAndTrees.lean"]
  Comp --> Tree["TreeConjugacy.lean<br/>Thm 2.58"]
  Bip --> Mix["MixedSign.lean<br/>Cor 1.5, Prop 3.5"]
  Odd --> Cyc["CyclesAndDeletion.lean<br/>Lem 3.21, Thm 1.6"]
  Cyc --> Para["ParabolicTransfer.lean<br/>Thm 1.2"]
  Cyc --> Clas["ClassicalDeletion.lean<br/>Thm 3.9, Cor 1.3"]
  Clas --> Pres["CoxeterPresentation.lean<br/>Thm 3.9: Deletion ⇒ Coxeter"]
  Pres --> CDel["ClassicalCoxeterDeletion.lean<br/>Thm 3.9: Coxeter ⇔ Deletion ⇔ Exchange"]
  How --> Spec["SpectralRadius.lean<br/>Ex 3.29, Thm 1.7 / Ex 3.33"]
  Spec --> AltSq["AlternatingSquare.lean<br/>Q2.59 &amp; Q3.35: C₄(+,−,+,−)"]
  Basic --> OddDef["OddCycleSingleDefect.lean<br/>C_{2m+1}(+,−,…,−): (w−I)^{2m}(w+I)=0"]
  How --> EvenDef["EvenCycleSingleDefect.lean<br/>C_{2m}(+,−,…,−): ∃λ ∈ (−5, −1)"]
  EvenDef --> BipDual["BipartiteDuality.lean<br/>Bipartite sign-flip duality"]
  How --> TwoDef["TwoDefectCycle.lean<br/>Cₙ(+,+,−,…,−): ρ(w) &gt; 1 (n ≥ 3)"]
  Spec --> SCls["SpectralClassification.lean<br/>Thm 3.27, Thm 3.28"]
  Mix --> Rem["RemarksAndClassical.lean"]
```
